source.implements: Import (the sheet): the input (a file's bytes or pasted text) is read by WH_IMPORT.read in any of New Recruit's formats; a refused one lists every reason, one per line, and nothing is kept; the list gets the id local- and 12 hex of the sha256 of the kept export (WH_IMPORT.localId): an export already kept says Already imported with its Open; it is made by WH_IMPORT.make (built from the tables for a catalogued faction, copied otherwise) under the List name given (else the export's), kept as { id, name, date, json, listName } and made again at every start; Update from a new export replaces the list it updates (its star, ticks and checklist kept when the new export has the same id); a phone that cannot keep it says so

an imported list's Overview ends with where it came from and when, how it was made (built from its export and the app's tables of its faction, or copied from units the app's own lists have, its faction having no full catalogue), whether this phone keeps it, GW's points where the export's differ (each unit with both values), and Remove this list (a confirm on the page: Remove / Keep it)

what Remove and Update take off the phone for one kept list: the kept export, the list, its out-of-date row, its per-battle ticks (wh-used-<id>), its Phase checklist boxes (wh-check-<id>) and its star
Remove: the list leaves the phone (the kept export, the list, its per-battle ticks and its Phase checklist boxes), the app goes to the home screen
